To Our Patients:
In order to provide the highest level of care, we have adopted some general policies.
- [1] —. We are dedicated to staying on schedule, so please be on time for your
appointment. We recommend arriving ten minutes early in case any forms need to be
completed. - 2-. If vou need to change vour appointment, please notity us at
least 24 hours in advance. — [3] —. If vou have an urgent problem, we suggest that
you call our office immediately so we may see you as soon as possible. — [4] —
